title: iFLYTEK Officially Launches Spark-ASR-2.0, Fully Empowering Hardware and Open Ecosystem
excerpt: Speech recognition large models have undergone a significant technological upgrade. On September 23, iFLYTEK officially launched the new generation speech recog
content_html:
Speech recognition large models have undergone a significant technological upgrade. On September 23, iFLYTEK officially launched the new generation speech recognition large model Spark-ASR-2.0, marking a crucial step in its voice interaction and intelligent hardware applications.

Regarding the specific release and implementation schedule, the model will gradually be rolled out in iFLYTEK Input Method starting from the next day (September 24), and API services will be fully available to developers and enterprise customers through the iFLYTEK Open Platform. In addition, Spark-ASR-2.0 will be deeply integrated into a series of core software and hardware products, including iFLYTEK AI Glasses, iFLYTEK Smart Office Book, and iFLYTEK Meeting, continuously expanding the application boundaries of acoustic large models in diverse scenarios.
